title: First True Digit in a Positive-Value List
statement: For every Boolean list $s$ whose binary value is nonzero, there are a natural number $j$ and a Boolean list $r$ such that $s$ consists of $j$ false digits followed by a true digit and then $r$.
hypotheses_covered: the binary value of $s$ is nonzero
